hindi: “दूसरे के परिग्रह में डाला गया बीज क्षेत्र वाले का है,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: “In another's possession (parigraha), the seed that has been cast [belongs] to the owner of the field,” say the teachers.
notes: Predicate 'belongs' is supplied (genitive kṣetriṇaḥ). parigraha = taking, possession; whether 'another's wife' is meant is not stated, so the literal sense is kept. Hindi 'है' is a bare copula. The closing iti is carried by the quotation marks.

hindi: “माता धौंकनी है; जिसका वीर्य है, उसकी सन्तान है,” ऐसा दूसरे कहते हैं।
english: “The mother [is] a bellows; whose the seed [is], his [is] the offspring,” say others.
notes: bhastrā = bellows or leather bag (the mother as mere container). retas = seed (semen). Copulas are supplied.

words.gram: n. nom. sg. pres. pass. part. √vid

hindi: “दोनों विद्यमान हैं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “Both [are] present,” says Kautilya.
notes: No quotation marks are printed in the e-text; the iti X formula is followed as in the glossary. 'Both' presumably means the seed (unit 1) and the field/mother (unit 2), but the line does not say so; the exact legal consequence is not stated. Alternative: vidyamāna 'valid, existing as a claim'.

hindi: जो स्वयं उत्पन्न हुआ, जिसके विषय में क्रिया की जा चुकी है उसमें, वह औरस है।
english: One born of oneself in her for whom the rite has been performed [is] an aurasa.
notes: kṛta-kriyāyām is feminine locative: 'in her for whom the rite has been done'. The rite (kriyā) is not named; 'the wife' is the evident sense but is not stated. Hindi word order follows the Sanskrit and supplies no noun.

hindi: उसके समान पुत्रिका का पुत्र है।
english: The son of a putrikā [is] equal to him.
notes: tena refers back to the aurasa of unit 4. putrikā is kept as a term (literally 'little daughter'); the text does not define it.

hindi: सगोत्र अथवा अन्य गोत्र वाले नियुक्त पुरुष द्वारा क्षेत्र में उत्पन्न पुत्र क्षेत्रज पुत्र है।
english: A son born in the field through one appointed, of the same gotra or of another gotra, [is] a kṣetraja son.
notes: 'Field' (kṣetra) is kept literal; its sense 'wife' is not stated here. 'Man' is not in the Sanskrit (niyuktena is a bare masculine instrumental); Hindi 'पुरुष' follows the masculine form.

hindi: जनक के दूसरा पुत्र न होने पर वही दो पिता वाला अथवा दो गोत्र वाला, दोनों के भी स्वधा और रिक्थ का भागी होता है।
english: When the begetter has no other son, that very one, having two fathers or two gotras, becomes a sharer in the svadhā and the inheritance of both.
notes: janayituḥ is read with putre ('the begetter's other son'). svadhā = the offering to the ancestors, kept as svadhā. 'Both' = the begetter and the owner of the field (inferred, not stated). dvi-pitṛkaḥ / dvi-gotraḥ are bahuvrīhi.

hindi: उसके समान धर्म वाला; किन्तु बन्धुओं के घर में गुप्त रूप से उत्पन्न हुआ गूढज है।
english: [One] of the same standing as that; but one born secretly in the house of relatives [is] a gūḍhaja.
notes: GROUPING: tat-sadharmā may instead be the epithet of the gūḍhaja ('the gūḍhaja, equal in standing to that, is one born secretly in the relatives' house'); what 'that' (tat) refers to is not stated (presumably the kṣetraja of unit 6). Kept as a verbless clause. sadharman = 'having the same dharma'.

hindi: बन्धु द्वारा त्यागा हुआ अपविद्ध है; वह संस्कार करने वाले का पुत्र है।
english: One abandoned by a relative [is] an apaviddha; [he is] the son of the one who performs the rites.
notes: saṃskartṛ = one who performs the saṃskāra (rite); the rite is not named.

hindi: कन्या का गर्भ कानीन है।
english: The embryo of a maiden [is] a kānīna.
notes: kānīna is kept as a name; garbha is literally 'embryo, conception'.

hindi: गर्भ सहित विवाहित स्त्री का सहोढ है।
english: [The son] of a woman married with an embryo [is] a sahoḍha (married together).
notes: sahoḍha is kept as a term. 'Son' is supplied in English only; Hindi supplies nothing.

hindi: पुनर्भूता स्त्री का पौनर्भव है।
english: [The son] of a woman who has become [so] again [is] a paunarbhava.
notes: Literally 'of one who has become again'; punarbhū as the term for a remarried woman is not stated in the line, so it is not imported. Hindi keeps the Sanskrit participle.

hindi: स्वयं उत्पन्न पिता का और बन्धुओं का उत्तराधिकारी है।
english: One born of oneself [is] heir of the father and of the relatives.
notes: svayaṃ-jātaḥ is the same phrase as in unit 4 (there glossed as the aurasa).

hindi: दूसरे से उत्पन्न संस्कार करने वाले का ही है, बन्धुओं का नहीं।
english: One born of another [is heir] of the performer of rites only, not of the relatives.
notes: dāyāda 'heir' is carried over from unit 13 and bracketed in English; Hindi leaves the predicate unspoken.

hindi: उसके समान धर्म वाला; माता-पिता द्वारा जल से छोड़ा हुआ दत्त है।
english: [One] of the same standing as that; [one] released by mother and father with water [is] a datta.
notes: As in unit 8, what tat refers to is not stated. adbhiḥ = with water (a rite with water is implied but not described). Dual instrumental mātā-pitṛbhyām is read as 'by mother and father'; the dual ending is also dative/ablative, so 'for/from mother and father' is possible.

hindi: स्वयं अथवा बन्धुओं द्वारा पुत्र-भाव को प्राप्त हुआ उपगत है।
english: One who has come to the state of a son, by himself or by relatives, [is] an upagata.
notes: Two forms of upagata: the first is the participle in the compound putra-bhāva-upagataḥ (visarga dropped before the next word), the second is the term. Whether svayam and bandhubhiḥ belong to the coming or to a lost verb is not stated; read together as 'by himself or by relatives'.

hindi: पुत्रत्व में नियुक्त किया गया कृतक है।
english: One appointed to sonship [is] a kṛtaka.
notes: adhi-√kṛ is rendered 'appointed'; 'placed in charge' is the alternative. kṛtaka is literally 'made'.

hindi: खरीदा हुआ क्रीत है।
english: One purchased [is] a krīta.

text_flags.why: possible stray daṇḍa inside the line before the closing iti

notes: The closing iti sums up the list of sons begun in unit 4; it is not translated as 'thus'. A daṇḍa '|' is printed inside the line before iti (the unit's own final daṇḍa is in trailers).

hindi: औरस के उत्पन्न होने पर सवर्ण तीसरा अंश लेने वाले होते हैं, असवर्ण भोजन और वस्त्र के भागी होते हैं।
english: When an aurasa has been born, the savarṇa [sons] take a third share, the asavarṇa [sons] are sharers of food and clothing.
notes: 'Sons' is supplied (savarṇāḥ, asavarṇāḥ are bare masculine plurals). 'Third share' = the third part of the share; whose share is not stated.

hindi: ब्राह्मण और क्षत्रिय के अनन्तरा-पुत्र सवर्ण हैं; एक अन्तर वाले असवर्ण हैं।
english: Of a brāhmaṇa and a kṣatriya, the sons of the immediately next [woman] are savarṇa; [the sons of the woman] with one [varṇa] intervening are asavarṇa.
notes: Elliptical: anantarā-putrāḥ is read as 'sons of the next (woman)'; eka-antarā(ḥ) with putrāḥ omitted, and the printed antarā could be nom. pl. antarāḥ with visarga dropped before asavarṇāḥ. The 'woman' and 'varṇa' are supplied; the line does not name them.

hindi: ब्राह्मण का वैश्या में अम्बष्ठ, शूद्रा में निषाद अथवा पारशव।
english: Of a brāhmaṇa, in a vaiśya woman [is born] an ambaṣṭha; in a śūdra woman, a niṣāda or a pāraśava.
notes: Verb 'is born' supplied. ambaṣṭha, niṣāda, pāraśava are class names kept as printed.

hindi: क्षत्रिय का शूद्रा में उग्र।
english: Of a kṣatriya, in a śūdra woman, an ugra [is born].
notes: Verb supplied in English only. ugra is a name (literally 'fierce').

hindi: वैश्य का शूद्र ही।
english: Of a vaiśya, a śūdra only [is born].
notes: Elliptical: the earlier frame (unit 21: son in a woman of a lower varṇa) is carried over; the line itself names no woman.

words.gloss: in women of the same varṇa

hindi: और इनके सवर्ण स्त्रियों में, व्रतों का आचरण न किए हुओं से उत्पन्न व्रात्य हैं।
english: And those born of these, in women of the same varṇa, from [those who have] not practised the vows, [are] vrātyas.
notes: Grammar is loose: acarita-vratebhyaḥ (ablative plural) is read as 'from those with vows not practised' and the persons are supplied; 'these' (eṣām) = the men of the classes just listed. Alternative: 'from the unobserved vows'.

hindi: ये अनुलोम हैं।
english: Such [are] the anulomas.
notes: Closing iti summing up the preceding section; glossed 'closing particle'. anuloma = literally 'with the hair/grain'.

hindi: शूद्र से आयोगव, क्षत्त और चाण्डाल।
english: From a śūdra, [are born] the āyogava, the kṣatta and the caṇḍālas.
notes: The women are not named in the line. kṣatta (compound-initial form of kṣattṛ) is kept as printed.

hindi: वैश्य से मागध और वैदेहक।
english: From a vaiśya, [are born] the māgadha and the vaidehaka.
notes: Class names kept as printed; vaidehaka is not 'trader' here.

hindi: क्षत्रिय से सूत।
english: From a kṣatriya, a sūta [is born].
notes: Verb supplied in English only.

hindi: किन्तु पौराणिक सूत दूसरा है, और मागध; ब्रह्म-क्षत्र से भेद है।
english: But the paurāṇika sūta is another, and the māgadha; [there is] a distinction from the brahma-kṣatra.
notes: Obscure. Possible readings: 'another sūta, the paurāṇika, and a māgadha, distinct from [the sūta and māgadha born of] brahma-kṣatra'; or the sūta and māgadha here arise from the brāhmaṇa-and-kṣatriya pair. The literal order is kept and nothing is resolved. brahma-kṣatra taken as dvandva neuter 'brāhmaṇas and kṣatriyas'; paurāṇika = of the purāṇas (old tales), kept untranslated.

hindi: ये वे प्रतिलोम राजा के स्वधर्म के अतिक्रमण से उत्पन्न होते हैं।
english: These, the pratilomas, arise from the king's transgression of own dharma.
notes: rājñaḥ (genitive) is taken with atikramāt: 'the king's transgression'. Alternative: 'from the transgression of own dharma [by those concerned], of the king', i.e. rājñaḥ governed otherwise. 'Own dharma' is whose is not stated.

hindi: उग्र से निषाद स्त्री में कुक्कुट होता है, उलटे क्रम में पुल्कस।
english: From an ugra, in a niṣāda woman, a kukkuṭa [is born]; in the reverse, a pulkasa.
notes: 'Reverse' = a niṣāda man and an ugra woman; this is the natural reading but is not spelled out.

hindi: अम्बष्ठ से वैदेहिका स्त्री में वैण होता है, उलटे क्रम में कुशीलव।
english: From an ambaṣṭha, in a vaidehikā woman, a vaiṇa [is born]; in the reverse, a kuśīlava.
notes: kuśīlava kept as a term (glossary).

hindi: क्षत्ता स्त्री में उग्र से श्वपाक।
english: In a kṣattā woman, from an ugra, a śvapāka [is born].
notes: The '-' join of ugrāt and śva-pākaḥ is an unsandhied join in the e-text (two words). śva-pāka is literally 'dog-cook'; kept as a name.

hindi: ये और दूसरे अन्तराल हैं।
english: Such [are] these and the other antarālas (intermediate ones).
notes: Closing iti summing up the list; glossed 'closing particle'. antarāla = 'intermediate'; kept as a term.

hindi: कर्म से वैश्य रथकार है।
english: By work, a vaiśya [is] a chariot-maker.
notes: Alternative order: 'the chariot-maker [is] a vaiśya by occupation'. Which varṇa-mixture the rathakāra belongs to is not stated in the line.

hindi: उनका विवाह अपनी योनि में है; पूर्व और अपर में गमन, और वृत्त का अनुवर्तन।
english: Their marriage [is] in their own womb; [there is] going to the former and the later [ones], and vṛtta and its following.
notes: Obscure. sva-yoni 'own womb' probably means own origin or class, not stated. pūrva-apara-gāmitva, and vṛtta-anuvṛtta (vṛtta = conduct, course, or a name) are rendered literally; the latter may be 'conduct and conformity to conduct'. Not resolved.

hindi: अथवा शूद्र के समान धर्म वाले, चाण्डालों को छोड़कर।
english: Or [they are] of the same dharma as śūdras, except for the caṇḍālas.
notes: 'They' (the antarālas) is supplied.

hindi: केवल इस प्रकार आचरण करने वाला राजा स्वर्ग पाता है; अन्यथा नरक।
english: The king, conducting himself in this way alone, reaches heaven; otherwise, hell.
notes: 'Reaches' is shared by svargam and narakam; the second verb is not printed.

hindi: सभी अन्तरालों का विभाग समान है।
english: For all the antarālas, the division [is] equal.
notes: vibhāga = division, partition; what is divided is not stated.

hindi: देश, जाति, संघ अथवा ग्राम का भी जो धर्म जिसके लिए उचित हो, उसी से दायधर्म की व्यवस्था करे।
english: Whatever dharma of region, of jāti, of saṅgha, or even of village is customary for him, by that very [dharma] [one] should arrange the dharma of inheritance.
notes: tasya = 'for him', the person concerned; the subject of prakalpayet is unstated. jāti kept as jāti (birth-group); saṅgha kept as saṅgha. dāya-dharma = the dharma of inheritance.
